notes.title: Trains VR - update!
notes.content:
Hello guys! We've prepared an update for you, including these changes: 

1. We've rearranged the room, so you will find it easier to move around. 
2. We've updated all textures to high quality - it looks even better than before! 
3. We changed the lighting around the room, so now it is much more pleasant to look at. :)
4. We've fixed some bugs, so gameplay will be smoother and more fun. :)

Hope you'll enjoy it! Stay tuned :)

notes.title: Trains VR on Oculus GO and Gear VR!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, and welcome![/b]

As you may know (since you’re on this Steam page), soon, we’ll be releasing our brand new VR project - [b]Trains VR![/b] 

[url=http://pxlme.me/mS82DFzL] YouTube [/url]

It’s a fun, lighthearted puzzle game in which you’ll find yourself in charge of your very own train models and send them through crazy railroads to collect points to become the master of the railroads! 40 levels full of logical puzzles is not enough for you? You can also build your own route and take direct control of the train in the first person view from the cabin! Be careful, however, it’s very easy to forget that you must watch out for other trains to avoid explosive collisions!

[b]Trains VR[/b] is available from May 1, 2018, first on Oculus Go and Gear VR, and soon on other platforms (yup, we are talking about Steam VR). 

Don’t forget to wishlist it and most importantly - leave your thoughts and feedback on our discussion boards and in the comment section below!
